# AgentFi

> AgentFi makes any website AI-agent-ready. We auto-optimize your pages for machine reading and get your bots through firewalls legally — via Visa Trusted Agent Protocol and Cloudflare.

AgentFi has two products:

1. **AI Site Optimizer** (for businesses) — Enter your URL, we crawl your site, generate AI-optimized page versions with structured data and UCP-compatible commerce profiles, and serve them on your domain via transparent proxy. Product feeds become discoverable by any AI agent via open protocols (UCP, AP2).

2. **Agent Trust & Access** (for developers) — We perform a comprehensive security audit of your agent product, then issue cryptographic signatures so your bots pass through Cloudflare and other WAFs without CAPTCHA or blocks. Backed by Visa Trusted Agent Protocol. Includes purpose-bound virtual payment cards issued via AP2 mandates and Visa/Mastercard Agentic Pay.

## Standards & Protocols

- [UCP](https://ucp.dev/latest/): Universal Commerce Protocol — open standard for agent-driven product discovery, cart, and checkout
- [AP2](https://github.com/google-agentic-commerce/AP2): Agent Payments Protocol — open standard for secure agent-initiated payments with mandates and verifiable credentials
- [Visa TAP](https://agentfi.tech/#partners): Trusted Agent Protocol — agent validation standard recognized by major firewalls
- [Mastercard Agentic Pay](https://agentfi.tech/#partners): Tokenized virtual cards for verified agent transactions
